name: RadarChart
description:
Several measures on one scale, as a profile: the first spoke points up and the rest follow
clockwise, as a pie's slices do. Rings mark the scale, each series is an outline with a
wash, and pointing at a series in the legend brings it forward. Use it to compare the shape
of a few profiles; for exact amounts, or spokes whose order means nothing to the reader,
`BarChart` reads better.

The ring does not mirror in right-to-left text: its order runs clockwise from the top, and
position around a circle has no reading direction.

  micro    the outlines alone in a small ring; the first series' largest measure as a trail
  compact  rim, spokes and measure labels where they fit, passive legend
  full     rings with their values, measure labels, the interactive legend, the tooltip
           (every series at the spoke) and arrow keys that move to the spoke in that direction

props.name: domain
props.description: Fixed value range; the low end sits at the centre. Defaults to zero → the data, rounded to nice ticks.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: One factual line for the empty state (R2.5): "No samples in the last hour".

props.name: errorText
props.description: What failed and what to do (R2.4): "Agent offline — retry when NST-C106 reconnects".

props.name: format
props.description: Full control of the number (the unit is still appended). Receives the chart's resolved locale as its second argument.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name: what is plotted, for what, over when ("CPU · NST-C106 · last hour").

props.name: locale
props.description:
BCP 47 locale for this chart's numbers, dates and table. Default: the nearest
`LocaleProvider`, then `configureLocale()`, then `<html lang>`, then en-US.

props.name: measureLabel
props.description: Header for the table's first column.

props.name: measures
props.description: One label per spoke: three to ten read well. All share one scale, so compare like with like.

props.name: onActivate
props.description:
Click, Enter or Space on a spoke: its index and measure. While set, the plot shows a
pointer cursor and its accessible name says Enter selects.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Called with no arguments when the person presses Retry in the error state. The button appears only when this is set, `state` is "error" and the tier is not micro.

props.name: series
props.description: The series to overlay: two or three stay legible, since each outline hides what is behind it.

props.name: state
props.description: Controlled view state, including loading, empty and error states.

props.name: title
props.description: A visible label in Metric's label role. Omit inside a panel whose header already names it.

props.name: unit
props.description: "%", "GB", "ms", or a counted noun ({ one, other })… "%" sticks to the number; other units take a space.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
